# 10 Cent Agency

> 10 Cent Agency is a Bangladesh-based full-service digital 
> marketing agency built specifically for small and medium-sized 
> businesses, startups, and entrepreneurs.
> Tagline: Professional | Affordable | Unstoppable.

10 Cent Agency was founded to level the playing field — giving 
small businesses in Bangladesh access to the same quality of 
digital marketing that large corporations enjoy, at prices that 
make sense for growing businesses.

## Company Information

- **Founded:** 2026
- **Founder:** Md Al Amin
- **Location:** East Monipur, Mirpur, Dhaka, Bangladesh-1216
- **Website:** https://www.10centagency.com
- **Email:** hello@10centagency.com
- **Phone/WhatsApp:** +880 1615-144114
- **Business Hours:** Saturday–Thursday, 10AM–9PM (BST)
- **Free Consultation:** Available — no commitment required

## Mission & Vision

**Mission:** To empower every small and medium business in 
Bangladesh with professional, results-driven digital services 
at a price that lets them grow without fear.

**Vision:** To become the most trusted and accessible digital 
growth agency in Bangladesh — where no business is too small 
to deserve the best.

## Services

### Core Service 01 — Facebook & Meta Marketing
Full Meta ecosystem management from page setup to 
revenue-generating ad campaigns.
- Page Setup & Optimization (One-time)
- Content Creation & Post Design in Bangla & English (Monthly)
- Ad Creative Production with A/B testing (Per Project/Monthly)
- Facebook & Instagram Ads Management with Conversions API (Monthly)
- Monthly Performance Reports with ROAS tracking (Included)
More info: https://www.10centagency.com/services/facebook-meta-marketing

### Core Service 02 — Website Development
WordPress + Elementor websites that convert visitors into customers.
- Personal & Business Websites (One-time, up to 5–7 pages)
- High-Converting Landing Pages (One-time)
- E-Commerce Websites with bKash, Nagad, SSLCommerz (One-time)
- All websites include mobile-responsive design, SSL, SEO setup, GA4
- 1 month free post-delivery support included
More info: https://www.10centagency.com/services/website-development

### Core Service 03 — AI Automation & Chatbot
24/7 intelligent automation powered by AI and n8n workflows.
- AI Chatbots for Messenger, WhatsApp, Telegram (One-time setup)
- Facebook auto comment reply and lead-to-DM automation
- AI Automation Workflows via n8n (lead gen, order management)
- Multilingual support: Bangla & English
- 3-day free trial available
More info: https://www.10centagency.com/services/ai-automation-chatbot

### Core Service 04 — Social Media Management
Full monthly management of social media presence.
- Monthly content calendar, post design, copywriting
- Community management and AI-powered engagement tools
- Bangla & English content creation
More info: https://www.10centagency.com/services/social-media-management

### Add-On Service 05 — SEO
- On-Page SEO: keyword research, meta optimization, sitemap setup
- Local SEO: Google Business Profile, Google Maps, NAP consistency

### Add-On Service 06 — Graphic Design
- Brand Identity: Logo, color palette, typography, style guide
- Social Media Graphics: Templates, covers, banners, stories
- Marketing Materials: Flyers, posters, brochures, pitch decks

## Target Clients

- Small & medium businesses wanting professional digital presence
- Startups and new entrepreneurs building from the ground up
- Offline businesses making the leap online
- Budget-conscious owners who refuse to sacrifice quality

## Key Differentiators

- Enterprise-level strategy at small business prices
- Bilingual content in Bangla and English
- Transparent pricing — no hidden fees, no confusing jargon
- Long-term growth partnership, not just project delivery
- Dedicated ongoing support after project completion
- Serves businesses that large agencies typically ignore
